Definition: the neck (between the shoulders) as the place of burdens; figuratively, the spur of a hill
BiblicalUsage: The shoulder carries the load, the pitcher, and the yoke. Rebekah came out with her pitcher upon her shoulder, Saul stood head and shoulders above all Israel, and Isaiah promises that the burden shall be taken away from off thy shoulder and the yoke from off thy neck. Zephaniah hears the promise that the peoples will serve the LORD with one consent, shoulder to shoulder.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the shoulder is where strength and service meet. It carries water and wears the yoke, and I hold that God lifts the burden off the shoulder He means to free.
